help.title: How to use Goal Reader
help.daily: Practice every day: 5 minutes is enough; 10 adds a story like school homework.
help.install: Install: in Safari tap Share → “Add to Home Screen”.
help.guided: On iPad, Guided Access (Settings → Accessibility) keeps your child inside the app.
help.mic: If the mic fails twice in a row, the app switches to “Grown-up ✓”: you confirm the reading.
help.never: The app never says “wrong”. A miss plays the model and tries again.
help.florida: Follows Florida B.E.S.T. grade 1 standards and never shows a picture before reading: Florida law bans guessing words from pictures.
audio.title: Audio review
audio.help: Listen to each clip. Mark bad ones, then run: npm run audio -- --redo=KEY
howto.rhyme: He only listens (no reading). He taps the word that ends the same. If he misses, the app replays the two rhyming words.
howto.blend: The app says separate sounds (/c/ /a/ /t/). He says the whole word and records it. Listen together and tap ✓ if it sounded the same.
howto.syllables: He taps the drum once per syllable (ba-na-na = 3). Clap along with him.
howto.sound-it-out: He taps each letter to hear its sound, then reads the word. Tap ✓ if he read it right.
howto.review: Words he has seen. He reads and records; the app plays his voice, then the correct one. Tap ✓ if it sounded the same, or Try again.
howto.new-word: New words: he listens, sees the sounds, and says it 3 times (each one is a goal). You just confirm with ✓.
howto.challenge: A challenge word from school homework, split into syllables. It's normal for it to be hard: help him read part by part.
howto.sentence: Sentence by sentence: listen word by word 🐢, then whole 🐇. Then he reads each yellow word (tap ✓ or 🔊 Help) and finally the whole sentence.
howto.story: 1) The app reads the whole story, pointing in yellow (you can pause ⏸). 2) Then sentence by sentence: listen word by word 🐢, listen whole 🐇, he reads word by word (you tap ✓ or 🔊 Help), and he reads the whole sentence. Use ⏸, 🐢, 🐇 or ⏭ anytime. 3) He answers 3 questions.
howto.trace: He traces the gray letters with a finger or pencil. The app checks it.
howto.free: He sees the word for 2 seconds and writes it from memory. Then compare with the model and tap 👍 or 👎.
howto.tiles: He hears the word and taps the letters in order to build it.
howto.tricky: Two almost identical words (ship / sip). He listens and taps the one he heard. Hard for Spanish speakers: cheer when he gets it!
plan.grownup: Sit next to him. When he records his voice, listen together to his voice and the correct one, and tap ✓ if it sounded the same. Tap ? anytime to repeat the instructions.
set.check.record: Record his voice and play it back (a grown-up taps ✓) — recommended
set.check.mic: Automatic microphone (free, sometimes fails on iPhone/iPad)
set.checkHelp: Play on my own keeps practice going without adult approval. Automatic microphone modes send audio to the browser’s speech service (Apple or Google); listen-and-repeat needs no recording. Record mode keeps recordings in memory only.
set.pace: First reading of the whole story
set.pace.follow: Natural pace, pointing at each word in yellow — recommended
set.challenge: Add 1 challenge word a day (homework words: robin, flower, circle…)
sum.sentencesNone: No checked sentences yet. On each sentence, tap ✓ when he reads the yellow word.
sum.sentenceTotals: {read} of {total} words read alone · {whole} of {n} whole sentences
rec.error.denied: The microphone is blocked for this page. On iPad/iPhone: tap “aA” in Safari's address bar → Website Settings → Microphone → Allow (or Settings → Apps → Safari → Microphone). Meanwhile, listen live and tap ✓.
rec.error.no-mic: No microphone was found on this device. Listen live and tap ✓.
rec.error.unsupported: This browser can't record audio. Use an up-to-date Safari or Chrome. Listen live and tap ✓.
rec.error.busy: Another app is using the microphone (a call or FaceTime?). Close it and tap 🎙 again.
rec.problem.empty: The recording came out empty ({bytes} bytes). Tap 🎙 and speak once the button turns dark red.
rec.problem.silent: The recording has no sound (level {peak}). Is the mic covered, or the iPad muted with the side switch?
rec.problem.unplayable: It recorded ({kb} KB, {type}) but this device couldn't play it: {error}
howto.segment: Listening only (no letters). He says each sound out loud (/c/ /a/ /t/) and taps one box per sound. Then the app shows how many sounds it had.
howto.fluency: One-minute read (standard ELA.1.F.1.4). Tap Start when he begins reading out loud. While he reads, tap any word he misreads (it turns red; tap again to undo). When the minute ends, tap the last word he read. Don't help during the read.
howto.retell: He retells the story in his own words: beginning, middle and end. Tap ✓ on each part he tells, or 🔊 Hint to hear that part of the story.
fl.tapLast: Tap the last word he read.
fl.band: At the {band}th percentile or above for {season}.
fl.bandLow: Still below the 10th percentile for {season}: keep practicing calmly!
sum.fluencyNone: No one-minute reads yet. Choose it in 🎯 Practice a skill.
pr.title: 🎯 Practice a skill
pr.intro: Choose what to practice today. Each card shows the Florida B.E.S.T. standard and how he's doing.
pr.review: Start with 2 minutes of word review (recommended: keeps words from slipping)
pr.homeworkHelp: For 7 days, stories in automatic sessions practice this skill, like the school homework.
pr.useHomework: 📌 Also use as this week's homework
gate.quick: Grown-up: press and hold to open
topic.blend: Hears separate sounds (/c/ /a/ /t/) and says the word.
topic.segment: Hears a word and splits its sounds, one box per sound (up to 5 sounds).
topic.syllables: Splits words into syllables on the drum.
topic.rhyme: Finds rhyming words (a Kindergarten standard, as review).
topic.phonics: Pick a pattern (short a, sh, blends, magic e, -ed/-ing…): sound out, read and spell words with it.
topic.tricky: Tells apart near-identical words (ship/sip, thin/tin), hard for Spanish speakers.
topic.heart: Words learned by heart (the, said, was…) from the Dolch list.
topic.fluency: Timed one-minute read: words correct per minute against the Florida norm.
topic.sentences: Guided reading sentence by sentence: listen, read word by word, then whole.
topic.story: Choose the skill: order, alike and different, details, time words or the moral. Includes retelling.
topic.challenge: Homework words (robin, flower…) split into syllables.
topic.spelling: Hears the word and builds it with letters.
topic.handwriting: Traces and writes words he already knows.
set.check.independent: Play on my own — automatic mic, with listen-and-repeat if unavailable
sum.unverifiedHelp: These recent attempts were practiced without a reliable microphone check. They do not count toward accuracy or mastery. Listen to your child read them when you have a moment.
set.independentHelp: Five minutes, spoken instructions, tracing, and no adult approval steps. Microphone failures become unverified listen-and-repeat practice.
audio.coverage: {ready} of {total} voice clips installed. Missing clips use the device voice.
audio.soundReview: Review each isolated sound before phonics practice. Generated voices and device voices can say letter names or add extra vowel sounds; these clips need listening checks.
